youtube.title: The Rakshasa Rama Spared | Ramayana Ep 7
youtube.description:
"Kill them," said the sage. Rama spared one. ⚔️

At Siddhashrama, Vishvamitra began his sacrifice, sworn to silence. For six days and nights, Rama and Lakshmana guarded it without sleep. On the sixth day, Rama told Lakshmana: be ready. The altar fire blazed up. A roar filled the sky, and like monsoon clouds the rakshasas swept down; Maricha and Subahu rained blood upon the altar. Rama loosed the Manava weapon at Maricha, and it flung him a hundred yojanas into the ocean. "It stuns him," Rama told Lakshmana, "but does not take his life." Then Agneya, the fire weapon, felled Subahu, and the wind weapon took the rest. The sacrifice was complete, and Siddhashrama had earned its name, said the sage. At dawn, the sages spoke of a bow in Mithila that no god or rakshasa could string.

📜 On screen (Valmiki Ramayana 1.30.20, vulgate):
"Paśya lakṣmaṇa śīteṣuṃ mānavaṃ manusaṃhitam, mohayitvā nayatyenaṃ na ca prāṇair viyujyate"
(See, Lakshmana, the Manava cold-arrow, taught by Manu: it carries him off stunned, but does not part him from life.)
